# Morea Evidence Pack

> Morea is a non-commercial educational research prototype (personal reskilling) for practising an EU AI Act Article 4 literacy Evidence Pack: AI-use inventory, role-aware literacy module, quiz, optional policy draft, and a dated SHA-256-verified export. It is not a compliance service, not legal advice, and not a product for sale. Hosted at https://litrixeu.vercel.app (legacy Litrix host name).

## Key facts
- Article 4 (AI literacy) applies since 2 February 2025.
- Applies to providers and deployers in the EU; no SME size exemption from the literacy obligation itself.
- Morea produces an illustrative Evidence Pack for learning — not auditor-grade attestation.
- Local verification: upload evidence-pack.json at /verify.html. Optional demo code lookup also available.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://litrixeu.vercel.app/): Morea Evidence Pack overview
- [Inventory](https://litrixeu.vercel.app/inventory.html): AI-use inventory
- [Exposure intake](https://litrixeu.vercel.app/assess.html): 6-question classification
- [Verify](https://litrixeu.vercel.app/verify.html): JSON hash check / demo code lookup
